observations.description: 0-2 person(s) detected per sampled frame (median 0); persons present in 36% of 64 samples about 0.57s apart; CV reliability 0.81.
T2 first appears away from the frame edge at 2.2s.

prediction.temporal_summary: CAM_01: 64 samples over 35.0s; up to 2 person(s). T2 observed 2.2-12.2s (standing -> standing), standing-to-low posture change 6.7-8.3s. T1 observed 0.0-2.2s (standing -> standing).
uncertainties: Sparse sampling (about 0.57s between frames); brief actions between samples may be missed.
Boundary semantics (gates, walls, restricted areas) are unavailable; authorization cannot be determined.
Track association reliability is limited (fragmented or ambiguous tracks).
Posture labels are automatic proxies; the cause of a posture change and any medical condition cannot be determined.
